title: OpenAI Completes $7 Billion Employee Tender Offer
summary: OpenAI has reportedly completed a $7 billion tender offer to buy back shares from employees, valuing the company at $852 billion. This move provides liquidity to employees without requiring an immediate IPO. OpenAI also filed confidentially with the SEC in June for a potential IPO later this year, though the tender offer may delay it. The company aims to strengthen its enterprise business before going public, especially as competitor Anthropic shows profitability.
key_points: OpenAI completed a $7 billion employee tender offer, valuing the company at $852 billion.
The tender offer allows employees to realize the value of their stock compensation without an IPO.
OpenAI filed confidentially with the SEC in June for a potential IPO but may delay it.
The company missed internal financial goals, prompting a focus on enterprise business before going public.
Competitor Anthropic's profitability adds pressure for OpenAI to present strong financials.
